name: ficha_fundo_textura
prompt: Edit this stone UI texture into a MUCH QUIETER almost uniform NEAR-BLACK blue-tinted seamless tile. The original has far too much high-contrast noise, cracks and bright speckles. Reduce contrast dramatically: every visible pixel should be within RGB roughly (18,21,26) to (27,30,35), no black cracks, no bright pixels, no spot lighter than #1B1E23. Center color roughly #171B22. Fine exceptionally subtle tiny pixel-art grain ONLY, all grain variation at most 2-3 RGB levels. Any hairline cracks should be almost invisible, only 1-2 RGB levels darker than surrounding stone; no large polygon slab outlines. No directional gradient, no vignette, no motif, no focal feature, no text, no symbols, no border. Image is opaque RGB edge-to-edge. Square 1024x1024 or nearest square. Perfect horizontal AND vertical tiling: left-right edges match, top-bottom edges match, outermost row/column can have the same near-black #171B22 color with a smooth invisible transition to the near-flat inner grain. This is a subdued UI background behind 14px white and old-gold text, not a detailed dungeon-floor scene. Target max-minus-min luminance under 8 percent of the 0-255 scale, ideally under 5 percent. No transparency.
